nodes.summary: Harbor Vale is a coastal city of 240,000 people supplied by the Harbor Vale Water Authority.

nodes.name: Reservoir pipeline
nodes.summary: The Kessler Reservoir pipeline, built in 1961, supplies drinking water to Harbor Vale. HVWA chief executive Tomas Reyes announced in January 2026 a plan to replace the pipeline, which Mayor Ilse Varga called "a failure waiting to happen".

nodes.name: Eastside
